Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on the protein composition and PTMs of Neutrophil Extracellular Traps (NETs). While PTMs (oxidation, phosphorylation, acetylation) are a central focus of the results, there is no evidence of a specific PTM-enrichment step (like TiO2 or anti-K-GG antibodies) prior to LC-MS/MS; the samples were processed via acetone precipitation and StageTips. Therefore, it is routed as a base DDA LFQ workflow with PTM search parameters rather than a PTM-enriched modifier workflow.

scope: The composition of NETs produced ex vivo by resting and Phorbol-myristate acetate (PMA) stimulated neutrophils was analyzed by high-throughput Fusion Orbitrap technology
